question: 'Pandavani' is the most celebrated folklore of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandavani is a folk singing style that involves the narration of tales from the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata.

 
 
• The singing also involves musical accompaniment.
 
• Bhima, the second of the Pandava is the hero of the story in this style.
 
• This form of folk theatre is popular in the central Indian state of Chhattisgarh.
